title: Download scoped dynamic customer receivable report as PDF
description: User scene: download exactly the selected, authorized receivable evidence page and optional ERP-120 page subtotals as a paginated Chinese PDF. Reuse ERP-117 preview, current ERP customer-menu and salesperson scope on every download. Reuse the existing PDFsharp 6.2.4 dependency and SimHei font resolver from ERP-116; refactor shared font setup narrowly so both report types work in one process. Missing font fails explicitly; known and unknown remaining evidence remain distinct and no cross-currency sum is invented. Existing HTTP audit records the read-only download. Development only: no migration, production SQL, real database execution, arbitrary model SQL, writes, secret/.env change or deployment. Verify PDF and regression tests plus safe build/test.
acceptance_criteria: PDF endpoint reuses authorized bounded receivable preview and selected field order, rejects invalid filters or missing customer scope, and never returns partial unauthorized data.

PDFsharp renders paginated Chinese rows and currency-separated page subtotals; share the SimHei resolver safely with the existing sales-order PDF exporter and fail explicitly if the font is unavailable.
Designer offers PDF download with visible errors; tests inspect PDF signature, selected fields, page bounds, Chinese font failure and no cross-report font regression; document font prerequisite.
